event.description: Reduce d14 FF width from 23 to 22
event.proposal: family: feed-forward width; current retained incumbent is 2982 parameters at 99.9700%, a +0.97 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted result: attempt-0044, d14 with ff23 at 2982/99.97%; same-family failed result: attempt-0037, block-diagonal FF connectivity at 2624/89.01% (the prior d16 ff15 scalar boundary was 3072/56.60%); prior attempts in this family: 12. Hypothesis: the successful d14/ff23 step supports one more scalar reduction without changing FF connectivity; ff22 should yield 2926 parameters and directly measure whether the new d14 attention allocation has additional FF margin. This is more informative than changing attention or token representation because it is the nearest width interpolation and preserves all currently accepted mechanisms; the nearest untested alternative is ff21, which would skip this local boundary. Keep d14/h2/L2, MQA, independent head-local maps, affine-free block pre-norms, final learned scale without bias, learned positions, reversed operands, mixed-digit curriculum, and 30000 steps; retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly below 2982 parameters.
